lines.text: [warm] Your buyers stopped googling. They ask AI. Here's how to make it answer with your name.

SEO gets you ranked on Google. GEO gets you named — by ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, when buyers ask them what to buy. Different game. And it runs on one simple thing: how often the internet mentions you.
That's what this page grows. Mentions are articles across the web that name your brand — press releases and guest posts Ryze writes and places for you, every month.
And one press release never lands on just one site. Click the links — [curious] published on seven sites. Ryze pushes every release to a network of over three hundred news sources.
Why does that matter? When the next ChatGPT or Claude gets trained, it reads the whole internet. The more places mention your brand, the better the new model knows you — before anyone even asks.
Backlinks are the other half. Every one of these is a link from someone else's site back to yours — with the page, the keyword and the anchor it came with.

And they're not just for Google anymore. When ChatGPT searches the web to answer, it opens what ranks on top — big, high-traffic sites. Backlinks are what put you up there. So they raise your odds of being cited by AI too.
Now — how do you measure any of this? [curious] With prompts. Keywords are what people type into Google. Prompts are what they ask an AI — full questions, the way a real customer talks.
Adding your own takes a click. One prompt per line — and every prompt gets checked on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.
Add them, and they join every future run.
Then re-ask. [excited] One click runs every prompt on all four assistants and refreshes your numbers.
And here's where it all lands. Open the dashboard — and switch to GEO.
The big number is your share of voice. Out of all the brands the assistants named, how often it was you — and your rank against every competitor they mention instead.
Visibility over time — every run is a point on this line, so you see if you're gaining ground week over week.
Then visibility by assistant. ChatGPT and Claude don't answer alike — you can be strong on one and invisible on another. Now you know exactly where to push.
The sources — the sites assistants cite while answering, and how often your domain shows up in them. This is exactly where mentions and backlinks put you.
And every prompt, one by one — which assistant named you, at which position, and how that changed since the last run.
Finally, the payoff. Real visitors arriving on your site straight from AI chats — week by week, split by assistant, down to the exact pages they land on.
So — track the questions your buyers actually ask, grow your mentions and backlinks, and watch the answers change. [smiling] That's GEO, working for you.
